answer: The user response must be unaffected. Under Parallel Run the old (incumbent) implementation stays authoritative and serves the response; the candidate runs only for background comparison, so a candidate failure must never affect the response and its failed result is discarded rather than substituted. The old authority is kept until cutover, and routing can return to the previous safe path only if the behavior and data assumptions still hold. Parallel Run is limited to side-effect-free work; for side-effecting operations it is contraindicated, and a branch-by-abstraction rollout with monitoring is used instead.
